title: Warm White British White Asparagus Fish And Chips
description: A sweet and juicy British dish featuring white asparagus and fish, served in a macrobiotic-friendly fish-and-chips form, cooked on a comal and finished with a deglaze fond, perfect for a brunch mood. This dish combines the freshness of white asparagus with the comfort of fish and chips.
instructions: Preheat the comal over medium heat and prepare the white asparagus by trimming the ends and peeling the stalks.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper to create the fish coating.
Dip each fish fillet into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Add the vegetable oil to the preheated comal and fry the coated fish fillets until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the fish from the comal and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Add the white asparagus to the comal and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
If using white wine, add it to the comal and deglaze the fond by scraping the bottom of the comal with a spatula.
Return the fish to the comal and squeeze the lemon juice over the top of each fillet.
Serve the fish and asparagus hot, garnished with additional lemon wedges if desired.
Finish the dish with a sprinkle of salt and pepper to taste.
